Computing sums of univariates factors of sparse polynomials. key ingredient in the algorithm is the Essential Factorization Schemes. We hope that these schemes could be applied to handle richer classes of sparse polynomials. A natural question to ask is whether it would possible to extend the algorithm to compute multilinear factors of an arbitrary sparse polynomial. Another open question is to improve the dependence on the characteristic from polynomial to polylogarithmic. On a final note, Example 5.1 in [6] is followed by a question (quote): “Can the output size for the factoring problem be actually more than quasi-polynomial in the input size?” Our next example provides a positive answer to this question over fields with super-polylogarithmic characteristics.
